en: Black‑and‑white postcard view over a European city with dense historic buildings and tiled roofs. In the foreground is a busy street with pedestrians, trams, and early 20th‑century automobiles; shop signs are visible on the façades. In the background a steep, tree‑covered hill rises above the city, crowned by a prominent clock tower and fortification structures. At the lower right corner, the printed caption reads "Graz."
